ui.title: Coach
ui.label: AI explanation · Example
ui.question: Why is my heartburn worse at night?
ui.explanation: Leaving at least 3 hours between a meal and lying down may help with nighttime symptoms.
ui.next: Note when you eat and when you lie down.

frames.rationale: The opening frame connects a recurring situation to a specific answer. It makes the assistant’s value visible before asking people to care about tracking. The lead is a hypothesis based on the Brian direction, not measured conversion data.

frames.jtbd: J2 · Understand an existing test result

ui.title: Lab results
ui.label: AI explanation · Example
ui.focus: Near the lower end of this lab’s range.
ui.explanation: B12 supports nerve and blood cell health. Your clinician may want to check this result further.
ui.next: Would a follow-up test help clarify my B12 level?
ui.disclaimer: Illustrative lab data · Not a diagnosis

frames.rationale: A concrete result gives the explanation benefit a visible before-and-after: unfamiliar numbers become a readable explanation and a useful question. The B12 value and reference interval are synthetic demonstration data, not a real patient record or a universal normal range. A value of 220 pg/mL is not labelled reassuring or definitively normal.

frames.headline: Food choices. Less guesswork.

frames.scene: A woman and man deciding what to order in a restaurant.
frames.shortJob: When you want dinner out to feel like everyday life.
frames.jtbd: J1 / J4 / J5 · Choose a meal before ordering

ui.title: Menu review
ui.label: AI meal guidance · Example
ui.focus: Ask for the sauce on the side.
ui.explanation: Citrus and high-fat foods can bother some people. Your own response may differ.
ui.next: Ask how the dish is prepared and choose an adjustment.
ui.disclaimer: Illustrative menu · No universally safe foods

frames.rationale: The restaurant scene connects food guidance to social life. “Before you order” makes the moment of use immediate. The example suggests one explainable change without declaring the dish safe or predicting a personal trigger.
